parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, typically made of lightweight metal such as aluminum or stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and fit.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal for durability and flexibility.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral support and stability, resting on the right ear to hold the glasses in place.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge to fold or unfold, similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses. The frame is metal, and the lenses are polycarbonate.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the primary optical function of vision correction or sun protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary; only the attached legs move relative to it.
